machine: MacBook Pro Mac15,6, Apple M3 Pro, 36 GB, macOS 15.7.3
port: same compiled-image format, kernels and runtime binaries as the Qwen3.6-27B M3 target; only source pins added. Architecture verified identical tensor-by-tensor.

verification.prefill_parity_test: 24/24 pass; argmax identical on every run, zero NaN
verification.smoke: 2+2 -> 4; C max2 correct; capital-of-France in Chinese -> Paris
verification.mtp_output_parity: 5/5 matrix cases token-identical, MTP adaptive vs off

throughput_matrix.method: five-case resident-chat matrix, one process per arm, greedy seed 42, same prompts as the Qwen3.6 matrix

aggregate.definition: end-to-end = completion tokens / full request wall (prompt prefill + first token + decode); decode = tokens per interval after the first token

throughput_matrix.comparison_to_qwen36: 3.6 measured 7.91 -> 9.42 tok/s end-to-end (1.19x) on the same battery; identical graph, slightly better 3.8 draft acceptance

thinking_mode.implemented: per-request reasoning_effort (low/medium/xhigh/none) with the verbatim template injections; reply opens at <think>; reasoning_content/content split in stream and plain paths; preserve_thinking replay

verified.xhigh_stream: 301 chars reasoning + correct split answer (6 primes between 10 and 30)
verified.low_with_small_budget: 400-token budget exhausted mid-think: truncated thinking in reasoning_content, empty content, finish_reason length

quality_arc_easy_5.observation: every miss states the correct answer's content in prose without the required 'Answer: X' line; under the pinned no-think template 3.8 drifts toward explanatory prose where 3.6 scores 5/5 on identical prompts
